coverage_note: The official-map tier counts are checked against the bundled vanilla mission definitions. The coloured maps are visual guides; a community server can replace its Central Economy files and change item eligibility.

chernarus.label: Chernarus
chernarus.summary: Progress normally moves from the south and east coast toward the inland west and far north-west.
chernarus.image_alt: Chernarus loot tier map showing Tier 1 on the south-east coast, Tier 2 inland, Tier 3 in the west and Tier 4 in the far north-west.

tiers.description: Early-survival loot around the main fresh-spawn coastline and nearby settlements.
The first inland progression zone, with a broader mid-level loot pool.
Higher progression territory, including many valuable inland and military locations.
The highest standard Chernarus tier, concentrated around the far north-west progression area.

livonia.label: Livonia
livonia.summary: Progress moves from the populated north through the central transition and into the harsher southern forest.
livonia.image_alt: Livonia loot tier map showing Tier 1 in the north, Tier 2 through the centre and Tier 3 across the south.

tiers.description: The main starting and early-survival region around Livonia's northern population centres.
Mid-progression loot through the central band before the deep southern forest.
Livonia's highest standard tier, covering the remote south and its valuable locations.

sakhal.label: Sakhal
sakhal.summary: Progress wraps around the main island and then pushes west and south toward the highest standard tier.
sakhal.image_alt: Sakhal loot tier map showing Tier 1 on the north-east and outer islands, Tier 2 on the main island, Tier 3 in the west and Tier 4 on the southern peninsula.

tiers.description: Early-survival areas, including much of the north-east edge and several outlying islands.
The broad mid-progression area across most of Sakhal's main landmass.
Higher-tier progression around the western side of the main island.
Sakhal's highest standard tier, concentrated on the southern peninsula.
